title: Bill Richardson siphoning US nuclear secrets
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Bill Richardson siphoning US nuclear secrets, about 1990s at Los Alamos / Department of Energy, New Mexico, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Los Alamos / Department of Energy, New Mexico

tellings.quote: Bill Richardson was kind of in with the Clintons and he was a Secretary of Energy and he's there and he's just systematically siphoning American nuclear secrets.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in the 1990s Bill Richardson, who was Secretary of Energy, the cabinet member in charge of the department that runs America's nuclear weapons labs such as Los Alamos in New Mexico, was close to the Clintons and was "systematically siphoning American nuclear secrets." If true, it would mean the man in charge of guarding those secrets was the one leaking them.
